Read cost adjustment provenance

Source: R/cost-example.R
nis_cost_provenance.Rd

Returns the metadata recorded by nis_cost() or nis_design() when cost adjustment was requested. Data frame operations may drop custom attributes; call this on the direct nis_cost() result or on the survey design returned by nis_design().

Usage

nis_cost_provenance(x)

Arguments

x

A data frame returned by nis_cost() or a survey design returned by nis_design().

Value

A list describing the charge and CCR fields, CPI-U source and base year, annual multipliers, invalid CCR and missing charge counts, and output meanings. Returns NULL when no cost adjustment provenance is present.
